title: Feelings and Hopes
label: ch:ml-feelings-and-hopes
canDo: I can say how I felt and how I feel with the dative and tōnnuka, tell a feeling as scene or as event, and say what I hope to do or become.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-R345-feelings-and-hopes: feelings with enikkŭ … tōnni, sorrow with duḥkhaṁ and its visarga, and a wish with -ān āgrahamuṇṭŭ.
